critical_code_review_comments: server.py MANAGEMENT_ROLES include admin, super_admin, admin_wilayah - the live-chat endpoints therefore also grant access to admin_wilayah. Spec only mentioned admin + super_admin; if admin_wilayah is not intended to see the admin-team channel, restrict via require_roles('admin','super_admin') instead.

Both dashboard and website (Kelola Website) in SuperAdminDashboard.jsx use the same LayoutDashboard icon. Not a spec violation (spec only required Dashboard vs Ringkasan to differ) but two identical icons in one sidebar is confusing UX - suggest a different icon (e.g., Settings2 or Globe) for 'Kelola Website'.
LiveChat.jsx polls loadMessages every 15s; acceptable for internal admin coordination but consider server-side push (websocket/sse) once traffic grows.
server.py is now 6019 lines - modularization recommendation from prior iterations still stands.
Live chat POST returns 200 (should arguably be 201 Created for a POST that creates a resource) - cosmetic.
